weighted_priorities.description: The user explicitly requested 'keep it simple'. Minimal scope, no auth, no pagination, no background scheduling. Every design decision should prefer the simpler option.
Response time accuracy is a core product value (it is the primary output of POST /check). Correctness of the wall-clock measurement takes priority over micro-optimizing throughput.
better-sqlite3 is synchronous by design; the architecture must embrace synchronous DB writes rather than introducing async queuing that would add complexity without benefit at this scale.
This is an MVP. Avoid over-engineering for future requirements. Thin controllers, direct DB calls, no repository pattern overhead unless it naturally falls out of the structure.
The system is strictly local: single process, single SQLite file, no external services. All design decisions must respect this constraint absolutely.

escalation_triggers.condition: A component design requires async SQLite access or introduces a queue between the HTTP handler and the database write.
escalation_triggers.justification: better-sqlite3 is synchronous; introducing async patterns would contradict the chosen library and add unnecessary complexity. Human review needed before proceeding.

escalation_triggers.condition: Any component introduces an external runtime dependency beyond Node.js built-ins, Express, better-sqlite3, and a fetch/HTTP client.
escalation_triggers.justification: The stack is explicitly constrained. Any deviation changes the dependency surface and must be approved.

escalation_triggers.condition: A task requires modifying the SQLite schema after data may already exist (i.e., a migration).
escalation_triggers.justification: Schema migrations are out of scope for this iteration. If a spec change requires one, halt and escalate.

escalation_triggers.condition: The outbound HTTP request logic needs to handle authentication, cookies, or sessions on the target URL.
escalation_triggers.justification: No such requirement exists. If discovered during implementation, it signals scope creep and requires user confirmation.
